data.long_meaning: The name Bud has Old English origins, derived from the term 'budde,' meaning 'pal' or 'friend.' In the 15th and 16th centuries, Bud was also used as a nickname for the given name Edward or Edwin. In modern usage, Bud can be used as a given name for both boys and girls, but it is most commonly used as a masculine name.
